heroSummary: The Bambu Lab P1S handles Elegoo Rapid PLA+ natively with exceptional performance, reaching a calculated safe max print speed of 286 mm/s at 24 mm³/s volumetric flow. The stock stainless steel nozzle and direct drive extruder require no hardware upgrades, though venting the top glass is recommended during extended runs to prevent heat creep.
bedSurfaceRecommendation: Textured PEI Plate (no adhesive required; ensure surface is degreased with warm water and dish soap)
slicerTweaks: Set 'Max volumetric speed' to 24 mm³/s under the Filament > Flow ratio tab to fully utilize high-speed melt characteristics without under-extruding.
Enable 'Pressure Advance' calibrated to 0.022 to maintain crisp corner geometry at high acceleration rates.
Adjust part cooling fan threshold to keep the auxiliary cooling fan at 50-70% to prevent corner curling on rapid layer transitions.
Set outer wall speed to 200 mm/s and inner wall/infill up to 286 mm/s to balance surface finish with peak throughput.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Extruder clicking and subsequent clogging (Heat Creep)
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Chamber ambient temperature rising excessively due to fully sealed P1S enclosure while running bed at 60°C with high PLA flow.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Crack the top glass cover open with a riser spacer or keep the front glass door ajar during long prints to maintain chamber temps below 35°C.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Corner lifting and warping on large footprints
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Excessive drafts from the auxiliary fan blowing directly on the first 5-10 layers, or oily residue on the textured PEI plate.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Wash the PEI sheet with dish soap, set bed temperature to 65°C for the first layer, and set the auxiliary fan to 0% for the first 10mm of print height.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Micro-stringing and fine filament cobwebs during rapid travels
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: High-fluidity resin in Rapid PLA+ combined with slight over-temperature (above 225°C) or inactive wipe on retraction.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Lower printing nozzle temperature from 230°C to 220°C and enable 'Wipe while retracting' with a 2mm wipe distance in OrcaSlicer.

faq.question: Can I print Elegoo Rapid PLA+ with the P1S door and top glass completely closed?
faq.answer: It is not recommended for prints lasting over 1 hour. PLA has a low glass transition temperature (~55-60°C), and an enclosed P1S chamber can trap heat, causing heat creep inside the cold zone and leading to extruder clogs. Prop the lid or door slightly.

faq.question: Do I need to upgrade to a hardened steel nozzle to run Elegoo Rapid PLA+?
faq.answer: No. Elegoo Rapid PLA+ is non-abrasive and runs cleanly through the stock 0.4mm stainless steel nozzle on the P1S without premature wear.

faq.question: Why does OrcaSlicer cap my speeds below 286 mm/s even if I manually set the travel speed higher?
faq.answer: The slicer dynamically throttles linear speed based on the 24 mm³/s Max Volumetric Flow limit. At standard 0.2mm layer heights and 0.42mm line widths, speed will peak at roughly 286 mm/s to prevent under-extrusion.

faq.question: Does Elegoo Rapid PLA+ need to be dried before printing on the P1S?
faq.answer: Generally no, as it is non-hygroscopic compared to engineering materials like PETG or Nylon. However, if exposed to high ambient humidity for weeks, drying at 45-50°C for 4 hours will eliminate minor surface popping and stringing.
